description: ASAP7 Process GNN MAML architecture sweep (11D node features: 7 base + 4 process params)

_comments.output_node_idx_note: output_node_idx is dynamically determined from topology cache (fallback default: 2)
_comments.resume_note: Set auto_resume=true to automatically find and continue from latest checkpoint. Set resume to a specific .pth file path. additional_iterations overrides total_iterations when resuming.
_comments.cache_path_note: gatectrl is auto-detected from cache_path filename. Available caches: stage_aware_topology_cache_asap7.pth (default), stage_aware_topology_cache_asap7_gatectrl.pth (with gate control edges). gatectrl only affects adjacency matrix (cache), not train data file.
_comments.inputport_note: Set 'inputport': true to use inputport topology. Inputport affects node features, so train file changes to train_cell_stage_aware_inputport_10pct.pth
_comments.checkpoint_suffix_note: checkpoint_suffix is auto-generated: cache_suffix (gatectrl from cache_path) + topology_suffix (inputport). Example: gatectrl cache + inputport = checkpoints_gatectrl_inputport/
_comments.related_pin_only_note: Set 'related_pin_only': true to use dataset with _relpin suffix (input_slew assigned only to related_pin MOS/port). Independent of inputport - works with both topologies.
